blurb: A hovering two-seater: the pilot fires twin blasters ahead, the passenger shoots their own gun

notes.model: Cyber Fang Mk III (Meshy Community, CC0; content/guns.json vehicles/cyber_fang.glb, 2026-11-10): a heavy hover bike, 4.0 m long, 2.2 m wide and 2.2 m tall over its front fairing. The Quaternius Striker it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/speeder.glb).
notes.seats: Measured on the model: the saddle at z -0.7 to -0.9, 1.6-1.7 m up, behind the fairing (2.0-2.2 m); the passenger on the tail hump behind it (z -1.3, 1.9 m). Roles, the pilot's blasters and their arc unchanged. Both sit astride (2026-11-11: they stood knee-deep in the saddle): the pilot on the saddle 1.65 m up, the passenger on the tail hump 1.9 m up.
notes.cockpitEye: Over the fairing, so the pilot sees the way ahead.
